ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white/cream pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white central region on both lobes; low-intensity black peripheral banding along the outer edges and tips; scattered low-intensity focal spots (mottling) distributed across the white mid-sections; subtle low-intensity brownish staining concentrated near the lower central axis.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the visible outer lobe boundaries, characterized by jagged peaks and depressions exacerbated by calcified barnacle protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex vertical sweep trajectory on both the left and right visible lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular white pixel clusters (barnacles) localized heavily along the dark peripheral edges of both lobes, with higher density on the right lobe terminal edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, low-intensity vertical linear disruptions (rake marks or pigmentation streaks) visible on the mid-to-lower sections of the white ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and associated calcified scarring along the trailing edges and tips of both lobes.
